stories.title: Rob Manfred says MLB owners won't compromise on a salary cap, leaving sport headed to a lockout
stories.summary: Rob Manfred said owners will not move off their demand for a salary cap, leaving the sport on track for a lockout starting Dec. 2 that could threaten the 2027 season.

stories.title: CMA Awards 2026: Dolly Parton honored with moving tribute
stories.summary: Parton died on Aug. 25 at the age of 80, following what her family said was a "brief" battle with cancer.

stories.title: Taylor Swift steps out at 2026 CMA Awards ahead of performance
stories.summary: Swift is performing at at the awards ceremony for the first time in 13 years.

stories.title: Remembering Xavier Taylor: 12-year-old NJ baseball player dies months after injury before game
stories.summary: The young South Jersey baseball player whose story inspired prayers and support from across the country has died.

stories.title: AccuWeather Forecast
stories.summary: Watch the latest AccuWeather forecast on ABC30 Action News.

stories.title: Charges dismissed against boxer Floyd Mayweather Jr. over bad check in Las Vegas
stories.summary: A court dismissed felony charges against Floyd Mayweather Jr. at the request of prosecutors, following allegations the boxer wrote a bad check to purchase a watch.

stories.title: Fiona the hippo: Cincinnati Zoo hopes a little shake will help her pass a swallowed hat
stories.summary: Fiona, the Cincinnati Zoo's famed hippo, underwent a colonoscopy this week, and now veterinarians are trying a new way to help her pass a knit cap that she swallowed.

stories.title: Americans will pay more for Thanksgiving dinners this year, Farm Bureau says
stories.summary: The American Farm Bureau Federation said the cost of an average Thanksgiving feast for 10 will rise 6% from last year to $58.63.

stories.title: What to know before Anthropic goes public
stories.summary: Artificial intelligence giant Anthropic stands poised to go public at a valuation north of $1 trillion, marking a major test for the AI boom.

stories.title: First-time Thanksgiving cook? Advice on turkey thawing, leftover storing and avoiding disaster
stories.summary: Rookie cooks nervous about attempting their first Turkey Day spread should plan in advance and leave enough time for frozen turkeys to defrost.

stories.title: China and Russia say they and US agree on UN reforms, boosting fuel supplies, dialogue on nuclear
stories.summary: China, Russia and the U.S. have agreed on U.N. reforms, to boost fuel supplies and to engage in dialogue.

stories.title: GLP-1s could be effective in children as young as 6. Should kids be using them?
stories.summary: New research shows Wegovy may be effective among children as young as 6. Some doctors are split about how widely GLP-1s should be used for younger kids.
